scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && npm run verify:pwa-precache
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.postgres-local.yml -f docker-compose.opensource.yml up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.postgres-local.yml -f docker-compose.opensource.yml down
scripts.load:k6: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.postgres-local.yml -f docker-compose.opensource.yml --profile tools run --rm k6
scripts.load:k6:crm: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.postgres-local.yml -f docker-compose.opensource.yml --profile tools run --rm k6-crm
scripts.security:zap: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.postgres-local.yml -f docker-compose.opensource.yml --profile tools run --rm zap
scripts.security:trivy: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.postgres-local.yml -f docker-compose.opensource.yml --profile tools run --rm trivy
scripts.test:architecture: npm run lint:architecture && npm run verify:architecture-coverage && npm run check:hotspots
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pretest:integration: node scripts/test/prepare-integration-env.js && npx dotenv-cli -e .env.test -- npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.pretest:e2e: node scripts/test/prepare-integration-env.js && npx dotenv-cli -e .env.test -- npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:unit && npm run coverage:integration
